avinash sable.name: Avinash Sable
avinash sable.summary: Avinash Mukund Sable(born 13 September 1994) is an Indiantrackathlete. He specializes in3000 m steeplechaseand holds thenational recordof 8:09.91, set at the2024 Paris Diamond League.[3][4]Sable has represented India in the men's 3000 m steeplechase event at the2020and2024 Olympic Games. He has been honored with theArjuna Awardin 2022.

gulveer singh.name: Gulveer Singh
gulveer singh.summary: Gulveer Singh(born 1 June 1998) is an Indianlong-distance runner. He is aNaib Subedarin theIndian Army. He has won two gold medals in the2025 Asian Athletics Championships, a silver and bronze in the2026 Commonwealth Games, and a bronze medal in the2022 Asian Games.

abinaya rajarajan.name: Abinaya Rajarajan
abinaya rajarajan.summary: Abinaya Rajarajan(born 21 November 2006) is an Indiansprinterwho specialises100 mevents and the200 m. She is an Asian Championships silver medallist, Asian Games and Asian U20 Championships bronze medallist.[1]

kiran pahal.name: Kiran Pahal
kiran pahal.summary: Kiran Pahal(5 August 2000) is an Indiansprinterwho specialises in400 mevents. She is the second athlete from India to go sub-51sec in 2024.[1]She qualified for the2024 Summer Olympicsin Paris in 400m.[2][3]At Olympics, she clocked only 52.51 in the heats.[4]

parul chaudhary.name: Parul Chaudhary
parul chaudhary.summary: Parul Chaudhary(born 15 April 1995) is an Indiantrackathlete who specializes in3000 m steeplechaseand5000 m.[1][2]She has represented India in both the events at the2024 Paris Olympics.

nithya ramraj.name: Nithya Ramraj
nithya ramraj.summary: Nithya Ramraj(born 20 September 1998) is an Indian athlete who competes in100 metres hurdles. She was part of theIndian contingentfor the2022 Asian Games.

neeru pathak.name: Neeru Pathak
neeru pathak.summary: Neeru Pathak(born 27 January 2007) is an Indian athlete who specialises in 400 metre run.[1]She qualified to represent India in women's 4x400 metre event at the 2026 Asian Games atNagoya,Aichi Prefecture,Japanfrom 19 September to 4 October 2026.[2][3]

neeru dhanda.name: Neeru Dhanda
neeru dhanda.summary: Neeru Dhanda(born 25 May 2000)[2]is an Indiansport shooterwho competes intrap shooting. She won the women's trap individual and team gold medals at the2025 Asian Shooting Championships.[3]In 2026, she won the women's trap gold medal at theISSF Shotgun World CupinLonato del Garda, becoming the first Indian woman to win a World Cup gold medal in the event.[4][5]

vithya ramraj.name: Vithya Ramraj
vithya ramraj.summary: Vithya Ramraj(born 20 September 1998) is an Indian athlete who competes in the400 m hurdlesand400 mevents. At the2026 Asian Games, she set a newnational recordof 54.75 seconds in400 m hurdles, beating a long standing record set byP. T. Ushaat the1984 Summer Olympics. She has won one gold, three silver, and two bronze medals at theAsian Games. She representedIndiain thewomen's 4x400 m relayat the2024 Summer Olympics.

pranavi urs.name: Pranavi Urs
pranavi urs.summary: Pranavi Urs(born 15 April 2003) is an Indian amateurgolfer. She won the gold medal in golf at the 2026 Asian Games in Japan.[1][2][3]
